title: Library timings and borrowing rules
text: The central library is open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, Monday to Saturday. The library is closed on Sundays and public holidays. A student may borrow up to 4 books at a time for a period of 14 days. The late fine is Rs. 2 per day per book.

title: Computer Science exam timetable notice
text: Provisional timetable for the December 2025 end semester examinations. The end semester examinations for Computer Science students will begin on 8 December 2025. Students should check the notice board for subject-wise dates.

title: Sports day announcement
text: The annual sports day will be held on 10 January 2026 at the main ground. Registration closes on 3 January 2026.

title: Bus pass renewal
text: Students using college buses must renew their bus passes before 31 July. The annual bus fee is Rs. 12,000.
